title: Tech Note: Cal4D Component - Language Reference
author: Dave Batton (Cal4D component author)

historical_commentary.text: This is Part Two of a two-part note covering the Cal4D calendar component for 4D 2004, providing a public-method language reference for developers who already installed the full-featured calendar component described in Part One. Only the short teaser abstract is available in this archive since the original distribution was a self-extracting .exe not accessible in this environment, so no method-level details can be assessed here. Cal4D was a third-party/partnerware component for adding calendar UI to a classic 4D 2004 database (pre-dating 4D's built-in Picture/Calendar form objects and pre-dating Project Mode and ORDA entirely), and any component built against that era's 4D API would need significant rework to run on current 4D versions.
